# Eigen 3.4.0

Unmodified Eigen/ headers from https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/releases/3.4.0.
Archive: https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/3.4.0/eigen-3.4.0.tar.gz
SHA-256: 8586084f71f9bde545ee7fa6d00288b264a2b7ac3607b974e54d13e7162c1c72
Licensing: COPYING.README and COPYING.*. Built with EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY and
EIGEN_DONT_PARALLELIZE for the native and WebAssembly Optimization Lab.

The libcmaes build also includes unsupported/Eigen/MatrixFunctions and its
implementation from the same Eigen 3.4.0 archive (SHA256
8586084f71f9bde545ee7fa6d00288b264a2b7ac3607b974e54d13e7162c1c72).
